SELECT DISTINCT e."id", e."name", e."event_space", e."capacity"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE e."event_space" LIKE '%Banquet Hall%'
   OR e."event_space" LIKE '%Conference Room%'
  AND CAST(e."capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200;
111:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
113:
SELECT DISTINCT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."id";
114:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_name";
261:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "salary"
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
JOIN
    max_salary_job msj ON j."jobid" = msj."jobid";
263:
SELECT DISTINCT sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "salarydetails" sd
JOIN "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%';
264:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
265:
SELECT "preferred_years"
FROM "jobs"
WHERE "salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs")
LIMIT 1;
266:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "jobtitle",
        "salary",
        "minimum_years",
        "preferred_years"
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    m."jobtitle" AS "position",
    m."salary" AS "salary",
    m."minimum_years" AS "minimum_experience_years",
    m."preferred_years" AS "preferred_experience_years",
    NULL AS "degree_level",  
    NULL AS "field_of_study", 
    NULL AS "required_skill", 
    NULL AS "proficiency_level" 
FROM
    max_salary_job m;

SELECT DISTINCT
    s."campus" AS street_address,
    s."city"
FROM
    "students" s
WHERE
    s."campus" IS NOT NULL
    AND s."city" IS NOT NULL

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT
    t."officelocation" AS street_address,
    NULL AS city
FROM
    "teachers" t
WHERE
    t."officelocation" IS NOT NULL;

FROM "facilities"
WHERE LOWER("type") LIKE '%rent%'
   OR LOWER("type") LIKE '%property%'
   OR LOWER("type") LIKE '%аренд%'
   OR LOWER("type") LIKE '%помещен%';
